description: Use when an EPS public estimate preview includes calculation_receipt and the user or agent wants to verify that the supplied normalized inputs and deterministic cost/pricing/evidence fields still match the claimed SHA-256 receipt. Integrity verification only. It does not verify identity, payment, provider signatures, site conditions, or firm-quote authority. Read-only and no persistence.

preview.description: The complete EPS public preview object returned by calculate_contractor_estimate_preview, including calculation_receipt.

name: verify_contractor_estimate_receipt
title: Verify an EPS contractor estimate receipt
